issues_found: The application cannot be started using 'uv run python main.py' due to missing MSYS2 toolchain for building pygame from source on Windows
The error occurs because pygame 2.6.1 has no pre-built wheels for the configured Python version and attempts to build from source
The build process fails at: FileNotFoundError when trying to run pacman command
workarounds: Use system Python with pre-installed pygame in global virtual environment
Install MSYS2 development environment for pygame source builds
Use pip to install pygame instead of uv for pygame specifically
Consider using pygame-ce (Community Edition) which has better Windows wheel support
recommendations: Consider providing pre-built wheel packages or Windows-specific build instructions
Document the MSYS2 requirement for building pygame from source on Windows
Update the build instructions to specify 'pip install pygame' on Windows before 'uv sync'
Consider updating dependency to pygame-ce for better cross-platform compatibility
Consider specifying a Python version constraint (<=3.12) that has pygame wheel support
